sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: Thank you for your quote. You are one of three foundries in our benchmarking panel this year.

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We appreciate being part of your benchmarking panel, but we ask that you share the comparative data so we can understand the basis of your target price.
In the spirit of our long-standing relationship, we are prepared to lower our price to €52.20.
To make this possible, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms and a 12-month contract.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months: €52.20 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: Your peers at the two other foundries both disclose their floor bands for the panel report; benchmarking without yours places you last in our ranking. What is your band?

move.text:
Guten Tag,
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
We note that your target price has decreased, but without verifiable data to support this, we cannot adjust our position.
We maintain our offer of €52.00 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We note your deadline for the benchmarking report on Friday, but as a matter of principle, our internal calculations and limits remain strictly confidential. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We have supplied you reliably for years, and our price of €52.00 reflects the fair value of our work. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 7 days. 

We maintain our offer and expect a realistic step from your side.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
